lead: Find, open and edit user accounts.

moderation.title: Ban account
moderation.reasonLabel: Reason (required, shown to the banned user)
moderation.reasonHint: At most 4,096 characters. A ban revokes every sign-in session. Timed bans are not supported yet: a ban lasts until it is lifted.
moderation.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than 4,096 characters.

banDialog.title: Ban {username}?
banDialog.body: The account is locked, every sign-in session is revoked and the account is hidden from the leaderboard.

banned.title: This account is banned
banned.unbanHint: Unbanning restores the rank "user", shows the account again and activates it.

impersonate.title: View as
impersonate.note: Superusers only. A superuser or a banned account cannot be viewed as.
impersonate.refused: This superuser or locked account cannot be viewed as.

dialog.title: View as {username}?
dialog.body: Your session will be replaced by {username}'s. You see and can do everything this person can, including submitting and commenting.
dialog.nested: Nested views are not allowed; stop with the button on the warning bar.
dialog.lastLogin: This person's last sign-in time is not changed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameHint: Shown in place of the username; leave empty to show the username.
profile.displayRankHint: The title beside the name; “banned” is set by banning.
profile.unlistedHint: Hidden from the leaderboards and member lists.
profile.notesHint: Seen by staff only, never by the user.
profile.leaveContest: Take the user out of the contest they are in
profile.emailPasswordHint: Changing the e-mail needs your own password, like setting a password.

password.title: Set a new password
password.warning: Setting a password signs the user out of every session and revokes their API token.
password.newHint: At least 8 characters, not only digits, not like the username or e-mail.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.currentHint: Confirms it is you making the change.
password.done: Password set for {username}; they were signed out everywhere.

reset.title: Send a password reset link
reset.note: The link goes to {email} and expires in 3 days.
reset.noEmail: The account has no e-mail address.

account.inactive: The account is inactive: the user cannot sign in.
account.banned: The account is banned; unban it to reactivate it.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate {username}?
deactivateDialog.body: The user is signed out of every session, their API token is revoked and they cannot sign in until the account is activated again.

account.renameHint: Letters, digits and underscores, up to 30 characters. The old name keeps opening the profile.
account.twoFactorNote: For a user locked out of their authenticator app or security key.

twoFactorDialog.title: Reset two-factor sign-in for {username}?
twoFactorDialog.body: Removes their authenticator app and every security key and signs them out everywhere.

locked.self: This is your own account: edit it in your account settings.
locked.superuser: Only a superuser can open a superuser account.

create.title: Create accounts
create.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate one, shown once after creating.
create.invite: E-mail an invite to choose a password instead
create.csvHint: A header line, then one account per line: username, and optionally fullname, email, password and invite (yes). Accounts are active at once; empty passwords are generated.
create.missingUsername: The header line needs a “username” column.

results.caption: Created accounts
results.summary: {created} of {total} created. Generated passwords are shown only now: download or print them before closing.

access.title: Roles & permissions
access.readOnly: Only a superuser can grant or revoke roles and permissions; you can view them.
access.isStaffHint: Opens the admin screens; what they allow comes from the permissions.
access.isSuperuserHint: Holds every permission and can grant them.
access.superuserHoldsAll: A superuser holds every permission, whatever is ticked below.
access.permissionsHint: Ticked: granted directly. A role tag: granted through that role.
access.saved: Access saved; it applies on the user's next request.

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: A role is a named set of permissions; members gain them on their next request.
roles.readOnly: Only a superuser can create or edit roles.
roles.name: Name
roles.nameRequired: Enter a role name to save.
roles.orgAdminNote: New organization admins join this role by its name; renaming it stops that.
